scope: Client configuration and builders, public operations, packet values and observations, diagnostics, wrapper-core public exports and the C ABI. Native module roots are explicit; codec methods are reviewed as excluded utilities, not required bindings.
exclusions: Arbitrary Rust-object/provider injection, foreign channels, mutable native state and standalone codec/session editing are outside the managed C client contract.
Bounded nonzero channels, finite publish accounting and MQTT 5 UTF-8 payload validation remain enforced.
Python and JavaScript public API exposure is separate work.
Caller pumping, runtime injection, custom retry control and parked or planned extensions are not completion requirements.

decisions.rationale: The hidden Rust callback bridge marks foreign buffer-release callbacks as host callbacks and restores the previous thread-local guard on return or unwinding. The C adapter invokes it around final storage release.
decisions.restrictions: No arbitrary Rust closure is exposed in the C ABI. Release callbacks obey managed blocking-wait restrictions and may run on the final owner thread; buffer release is independent of MQTT completion and context join.
decisions.validation_limits: Evidence checks callback reentry and wait rejection; it does not establish arbitrary foreign callback safety or execution on every platform.

decisions.rationale: C opaque buffer handles adopt immutable application storage through Bytes::from_owner. Immediate, tracked and deferred publish entry points clone that storage into the existing PublishCommand and bounded admission paths; independent handles share final release authority.
decisions.restrictions: The caller guarantees stable immutable storage and a thread-safe release callback until final release. Failed creation retains caller ownership. Topics and MQTT 5 properties still copy, UTF-8 checks remain enabled, and each admitted use pays its logical payload charge. Completion and join do not imply final storage release; no end-to-end zero-copy or RSS bound is claimed.
decisions.validation_limits: Ownership, admission, callback and retained-value behavior require executing the named tests. Native C ABI/export and Windows/macOS checks remain separate evidence; declaration review does not certify performance.

capabilities.name: Deferred C admission

capabilities.validation_limits: Linux validation; platform CI is separate.

capabilities.validation_limits: Linux correctness/ABI validation; original throughput/p99 gates remain unmet, with macOS/Windows execution outstanding.

capabilities.validation_limits: Linux validation; historical ABI and platform evidence retain their documented limits.

capabilities.name: Structured failures and first-connection observer
capabilities.rationale: Typed safe native failure details and historical first-success C observations are implemented.
capabilities.validation_limits: Linux execution; no complete native error or platform parity claim.

capabilities.name: Recovery-gate snapshot and detached ACK tokens
capabilities.rationale: The v2 publish-budget snapshot retains recovery_pending; detached tokens preserve single-use authority without payload ownership.

capabilities.name: Application-owned TLS layer
capabilities.rationale: Parked: no confirmed application consumer and corrected measurements failed the acceptance gate. No public C ABI implementation is required by this audit.
capabilities.validation_limits: Private Linux experiment is not public API support or performance acceptance.

capabilities.name: Maintained file stores
capabilities.rationale: Optional maintained stores and inactive-key administration are implemented with leases, bounded work and joined teardown.
capabilities.validation_limits: Local validation; native Windows/macOS execution remains pending CI.

capabilities.name: Owned immutable C publish buffers
capabilities.rationale: C immutable application-owned buffers are implemented with retained handles, final release callbacks and immediate, tracked and deferred admission through the existing native Bytes publish path. Borrowed-view APIs still copy.
capabilities.validation_limits: Ownership and controlled-transport tests plus native C fixtures provide evidence. Topics/properties still copy; no end-to-end zero-copy or RSS bound is claimed. Platform execution and performance remain separate checks.

capabilities.name: Caller pumping and runtime injection
capabilities.rationale: Conditional execution extension remains separate; readiness does not establish it.
capabilities.validation_limits: Not a completion requirement for parity review.

capabilities.rationale: Application retry decisions and pause/resume/request-attempt remain a separate follow-up.
